author: hyunback
title: LLM accuracy GPU test fails — Qwen2-0.5B-Instruct-INT8 metric drop exceeds threshold

failed_jobs.name: LLM accuracy iGPU tests / LLM accuracy GPU tests
failed_jobs.symptom: test_accuracy_conformance[Qwen/Qwen2-0.5B-Instruct-INT8-GPU] fails with AssertionError: Metric drop 0.05254477262496948 exceeds threshold 0.03

key_errors: FAILED tests/llm/accuracy_conformance.py::test_accuracy_conformance[Qwen/Qwen2-0.5B-Instruct-INT8-GPU] - AssertionError: Metric drop 0.05254477262496948 exceeds threshold 0.03
root_cause: The failed job (LLM accuracy iGPU tests) is unrelated to this PR's diff, which only touches the intel_gpu plugin's MoE grouped-GEMM scatter-reduction kernel (moe_3gemm_base.hpp, moe_3gemm_swiglu_opt.cpp, moe_scatter_reduction_opt.cl, moe_scatter_reduction_row_lut.cl) plus a unit test for that primitive. It does not touch the LLM accuracy pipeline, Qwen2 model handling, or any code path exercised by the Qwen2-0.5B-Instruct-INT8-GPU accuracy conformance test. This exact failure signature (metric drop ~0.0525 vs 0.03 threshold on the same model) has now recurred 5 times across unrelated PRs since 2026-08-27, confirming a known intermittent accuracy flake in the LLM accuracy GPU test rather than a regression from this PR. A same-signature rerun of this same run was already in progress (run_attempt 2) at investigation time.
reproduction_steps: Run `pytest tests/llm/accuracy_conformance.py::test_accuracy_conformance -k Qwen2-0.5B-Instruct-INT8-GPU` on a GPU-enabled runner multiple times; the metric drop value fluctuates near the 0.03 threshold and occasionally exceeds it, independent of unrelated code changes.
recommended_actions: Rely on automatic remediation (failed-job rerun) already requested for this transient failure; no code change to PR #37637 is needed.

Revisit whether the 0.03 metric-drop threshold for Qwen2-0.5B-Instruct-INT8-GPU is too tight given the repeatedly observed ~0.05 drop, and consider widening it or stabilizing the measurement (fixed seed/averaging) with a tracked ticket.
Reference pattern hash 47caedf70a4041f8 (5 occurrences) when filing/triaging a fix for this specific model/threshold combination.
prevention_strategies: Add variance/seed stabilization to the Qwen2-0.5B-Instruct-INT8-GPU accuracy check, or increase its threshold margin with statistical justification, to stop unrelated merge-queue PRs from being blocked by this recurring flake.
historical_context: Same signature previously recorded on 2026-08-27 (PR #37611), 2026-08-27 (PR #37768), 2026-09-03 (PR #37799), and 2026-09-11 (PR #37178) — all with the same or near-identical assertion message. This is the 5th occurrence in the CI Doctor MQ pattern database (hash 47caedf70a4041f8).
